The fully filled kit requires character level 36. Selected augments raise their hosts’ minimum level. The primary recipe has one Minor Artifact, Yeenoghu’s Reign; Claws Nearly Complete selects Wisdom +15; the Celestial Sapphire Ring’s Nearly Finished slot is empty. The no-event/no-limited policy allows only Festive ability diamonds as the exception. Acquisition screening, legal construction and source-certified effect totals are different checks.

Actual run, followed by manual refinements. The retained production run completed 45 stages in 271.998 seconds. The documented canonical craft rotation, Spot/Good Luck choices and Wisdom refinement derive the selected recipe; they are not a new solver run or proof of a global optimum. The raw output modeled Constitution 34; this practical selection models 32 after choosing Good Luck for saves/skills, and adds the provisional Slavers Extra Spot +20. The production run’s status is not an optimality claim for those manual changes. See the run, derivation and source-limit packet and exact selected manifest.

Damage first; certification is limited. Greater Marksmanship counts once (+3 ranged attack, +2 ranged damage). Goggles provide the selected 9% Enhancement Doubleshot. Modeled Ranged Power 44, Doubleshot 35, Seeker 29, Armor-Piercing 76, Deadly 20 and Intelligence 37 remain unverified combinations. Dusk Raider, Tough Shields, Quickblade and Perfect Silence each require three selected hosts; their model inputs are not certified by arithmetic alone. Perfect Silence’s modeled three sneak dice are separate from the selected Solar gem’s modeled three flat sneak damage. The Emerald’s modeled one imbue die and Chains Combustion require activation and scaling checks; no DPS percentage or wider critical range is asserted.

The 142 is a selected-gear Fire Spell Power contribution, not weapon damage, established imbue scaling, full-character Spell Power or DPS.
